system.description:
Trigger: A @Trait[weather] Effect is created by a creature other than a user using an Attack or Ability (but not Intense Weather).

Effect: The triggering @Trait[weather] is removed, and the source creature has their Activation delayed 20%. If the Effect and its source lack [Legendary], the source creature gains @Affliction[suppressed] 5 and the source Attack/Ability is @Affliction[disabled] 5 or @Affliction[nullified] 5, and has their Activation delayed another 20%.
